deletion_controls: Random deletion from all measured genes, matched per-set retained count

random_set_backgrounds: All variable measurable genes excluding original signature union

Union of explicitly listed GO Biological Process 2025 immune-related terms, defined by the keyword rule stored in immune_background_definition.json; excluding original signature union. Rule chosen before null outcomes.
matching: Nearest-neighbour randomized matching on gene mean-expression rank, SD rank and detection rate, without replacement within each set; report matching distances
overlap_null: In addition to independent random sets, map each unique original gene to one unique matched random gene to preserve exact overlap architecture
specificity: Target score rank versus PC1 of other scores; remove Shared84 from references except when it is the target; repeat references after deleting every target gene. Partial rank association with independent protein reference, adjusted for reference PC1 and additionally CD3/CD45. Report effect, bootstrap CI, BH within predeclared families; no TLS/exhaustion validity claim without appropriate reference
single_cell: Patient unit; selection audit 22 versus 5 excluded; technical covariates and equal-cell repeated downsampling if raw counts available. Immune-selected data cannot validate malignant/stromal contributions
independent_replication: Search for external HNSCC RNA plus histological/protein references; do not label an internal split independent validation
clinical: Secondary only; reuse existing training-fold intercept-only LOPO predictions if present; no new optimized signatures
